articles.title: Man given life sentences for 2024 double murder in Oshawa
articles.summary: Mark Gordon was sentenced to two life sentences without the possibility of parole for 21 years in the shooting deaths of Robert Montgomery, 42, and Andrieana Montgomery, 42.

articles.title: Lawyer sues Durham police for $7.1M over alleged violent arrest at Oshawa courthouse
articles.summary: A criminal defence lawyer who alleges she was violently assaulted by Durham Regional Police officers inside an Oshawa courthouse has filed a $7.1-million lawsuit against the regional police service board and five officers.

articles.summary: Toronto police say they located an injured male after responding to a call about a person with a knife in the Dufferin Street and Bloor Street West area on Wednesday afternoon. articles.title: Ceremonies at Old City Hall, Queen’s Park among those marking Remembrance Day in Toronto
articles.summary: As John Anderson prepared to lay a wreath at a Remembrance Day ceremony at Toronto’s Old City Hall, the retired Canadian Navy lieutenant said he would be thinking of people who were part of his service “brotherhood.” The Cambridge, Ont., resident who was in the navy for more than 40 years said taking part in […]

articles.title: SIU investigating after Peel police fire gun during traffic stop in Brampton, Ont.
articles.summary: A police officer conducted a traffic stop of a vehicle in the Kensington Road and Bramalea Road area at around 1:45 a.m. Wednesday, according to the SIU

articles.title: Former NFL coach Rex Ryan turns himself in after alleged Nashville hit-and-run
articles.summary: NASHVILLE, Tenn. (AP) — Former NFL coach Rex Ryan turned himself in to Nashville police Wednesday on misdemeanor charges after he allegedly hit two pedestrians with his truck in a popular area downtown last week and then drove off after an argument, police said.

articles.title: Did Stellantis violate its deals with the feds? Funding contract provided exceptions around Brampton
articles.summary: On Tuesday, Prime Minister Mark Carney called Stellantis' now-confirmed plans to sell an automotive assembly plant in Brampton, Ont., "a betrayal" of the global automaker's "obligations to Canada and by extension to all Canadians."

articles.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays are going big-game hunting again. Star free agent Tarik Skubal will meet with the Blue Jays next week in California, Jon Heyman of the New York Post reported on Wednesday. articles.title: 2 Mississauga men charged after allegedly stealing 9 coffee machines valued at nearly $86K: police
articles.summary: Two Mississauga men have been arrested and charged after allegedly stealing nine commercial coffee machines valued at nearly $86,000, Peel police say. Six of the machines have been recovered.

articles.title: ‘No adults without children’ sign taken down from Toronto park after viral debate
articles.summary: City of Toronto crews have removed at least one sign found in a local park that went viral online, prompting an extensive back-and-forth debate. articles.title: Police genealogy team IDs British man who died in Toronto 34 years ago
articles.summary: Months of work by Toronto police's genealogy team and investigators have unmasked a man who died in the city's downtown in 1992.

articles.title: Pickering Mayor Kevin Ashe considers using expanded powers for Durham budget as region's new chair
articles.summary: Pickering Mayor Kevin Ashe says he's considering using his expanded powers as new regional chair with the Regional Municipality of Durham during the budget process and to appoint committee leaders. He's among eight regional chairs appointed this week by Ontario.

articles.title: Stellantis auto plant sale draws optimism, hurt in Brampton, Ont., after 2,000 jobs lost
articles.summary: Workers and local politicians are expressing disappointment at Stellantis's decision to sell its Brampton, Ont., plant to armoured vehicle maker Roshel Inc., but some local businesses and experts say the new company could bring more jobs and foot traffic to the community.

articles.title: Male dead after 3 vehicles collide on Highway 410 in Brampton, police say
articles.summary: A person has died after a collision involving three vehicles on Highway 410 in Brampton, Ontario Provincial Police say.

articles.title: Peel police unveil new Brampton division, first expansion since 1987
articles.summary: The new $118-million police facility in Brampton will have capacity for 500 officers and bring investigative teams together under one roof, as residents weigh in on its cost.

articles.title: Stellantis plant sale: New employment program aims to help laid-off Brampton workers
articles.summary: With thousands of Brampton autoworkers facing an uncertain future, a new regional initiative is fast-tracking pathways into logistics and manufacturing across the Pearson Economic Zone.

articles.title: Police seek 2 suspects after 18-year-old fatally shot in Rexdale
articles.summary: Toronto police investigators are looking for two suspects after an 18-year-old was shot and killed in Rexdale early Tuesday.
